subject: The Bronze strand's plan set. AAE-R1B R3(ii) and R4: BRONZE = AUTHOR, 14 decks, 7 weeks x 2, BUILD band, theme 'My Creative Identity', authored from SPEC.json's Bronze level only. The exemplar SoWs, worksheets and decks are exemplars only -- never a donor, never a spec source, never copied. Nothing here was read off a deck.

level.title: Level 1 Award in the Arts
level.attemptedRule: ONE Attempted allowed overall. Any Not Attempted = Below Pass.

partWeeksNote: the order gives A 1-3, B 4-5, C 5-6, D 6-7. With fourteen decks over seven weeks at two a week and Part A taking six, B's third deck -- the review and the share -- falls in week 6 rather than week 5. It is recorded here as measured rather than forced back into the range: the share is the part of B that cannot happen until after the experience, and g34 wants it evidenced, not hurried.
routeAgnostic: every Part B deck ships route-agnostic: R1 we go, R2 they come in, R3 a live remote exchange. An online exhibition is a legitimate experience. Nothing waits on AAE-H2, and no deck names a venue or a date -- the venue comes from EVENT_SLOT, which is UNCONFIRMED.
cellsRuling: MEASURED, NOT GUESSED. The order says 'cells under BUILD Art'. EASTER_TARGETS.json holds 24 BUILD Art plans; batch 3 and batch 4 covered C102-C108, leaving 17 uncovered: C110-C115 (music and performance), C88-C93 (emotion and expression) and C94-C98 (drama). NOT ONE of the seventeen states a Bronze Part A-D outcome, so binding a Bronze deck to any of them would be a coverage lie -- a deck claiming to teach an outcome it does not teach. Inventing a cell reference is worse. So the Bronze decks claim NO workbook cell, and the binding is left open for a ruling rather than fabricated. AAE-H7.
g29Position: a deck with no plan cells carries no planId, and g29 SKIPs it rather than judging it. That is a fail-open and it is stated here rather than left to be discovered: fourteen Bronze decks will SKIP g29 until AAE-H7 is answered. Their coverage claim is the artsAward block that g30-g35 read and bind, which is a gate reading a declaration rather than no gate at all.

staffBlockOnEveryDeck.fileCap: 10 evidence files for the whole Bronze level

rows.title: Where My Art Is Now
rows.outcome: Record a baseline: one piece made today, and three words for what it does well and one for what it does not.

rows.title: What Getting Better Would Look Like
rows.outcome: Choose one art-form skill to develop, and write the measure that will show it changed.

rows.title: Practise The Skill, Session One
rows.outcome: Work on the chosen skill and record what changed between the first attempt and the last.

rows.title: Practise The Skill, And Take One Piece Of Feedback
rows.outcome: Work on the skill again, take one piece of feedback from a named person, and write it down in their words.

rows.title: Make The Change The Feedback Asked For
rows.outcome: Apply the feedback once, on the piece, and record what it did.

rows.title: What Improved, In My Own Words
rows.outcome: Summarise what was learnt across Part A against the measure set in week one.

rows.title: What An Audience Member Actually Does
rows.outcome: Name what an audience member notices, and why noticing is the evidence.

rows.title: The Review Frame, Before The Experience
rows.outcome: Prepare the review frame: the moment, the craft choice, the effect, and who it was for.

rows.title: The Experience, Captured
rows.outcome: Experience the arts event or exhibition through the route in use, and capture the moments on the frame.

rows.title: Choosing A Practitioner, And Saying Why
rows.outcome: Choose a real artist, craftsperson or practitioner from the approved pack and say why they were chosen.

rows.title: Quality, Impact, And Telling Somebody
rows.outcome: Review the experience for quality and creative impact, then share that view with at least one other person and evidence the share.

rows.title: Their Practice, Career, Life And Work
rows.outcome: Research the chosen practitioner’s practice, career, life and work, and record where each fact came from.

rows.title: Plan The Skills Share
rows.outcome: Plan a short workshop or presentation that passes on one arts skill to a peer, a small group or a staff member.

rows.title: Deliver It, Then Review How It Went
rows.outcome: Deliver the planned skills share, then review how well it went against the plan.
